title: Markov chain with absorbing barrier and reward accumulation
text: A token moves daily among states {0,1,2,…,L} with L = 8. From state i (1 ≤ i ≤ L−1), it goes to i+1 with probability 0.15, to i−1 with probability 0.35, and stays with probability 1−p−q. States 0 and L are absorbing. Starting from s = 2, you earn g(i) coins each day you are in state i (including the start day) until absorption, where g(i) = 1*i + 8. After absorption you pay a one-time fee 0 if absorbed at L (otherwise 0). Compute the expected net coins.
